items.label: Two Size Options for All Uses
items.value: Available in M / L sizes. The M fits tablets, wallets and small water bottles, perfect for quick errands. The L holds a 15.6-inch laptop, 30 oz tumbler and work files, ideal for daily commuting.

items.label: Multiple Independent Compartments & Neat Storage
items.value: Features separated individual pockets to organize your essentials clearly. All dividers are fully stitched to the bottom, preventing items from rolling around and keeping everything tidy all day long.

items.label: Secure Closure & Thick Reinforced Base
items.value: Comes with top zipper closure for anti-theft protection and private storage. The sturdy thickened bottom offers strong support, keeps the tote standing steadily, holds heavy items easily and maintains the original shape without collapsing.

items.label: Premium Durable Canvas & Exquisite Workmanship
items.value: Made of high-quality thickened waterproof canvas with polyester lining, lightweight, scratch-resistant and easy to clean. Precise tight stitching ensures long-lasting use. The padded laptop sleeve protects your notebook from bumps and shocks.

items.label: Adjustable Detachable Strap & Wide Application
items.value: Equipped with comfortable top handles and a removable adjustable shoulder strap, allowing hand-held, shoulder and crossbody carrying styles. Suitable for of fice work, school, travel, shopping, nursing, teaching and daily use. It is also an ideal gift for friends, family, colleagues and busy moms.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Machine washable, but specific instructions not provided.
